findings.text:
DSFSTG-3: 1 part to fix
DSFSTG-3[code]: In combined --resume --from-stage <s> mode, stages after <s> that are marked complete in the interrupted run's state are still dispatched covers: RQFROM-1
  Given: A previous run was interrupted; stages before <s> and stages after <s> are both marked complete; the runner is invoked with both auto-resume active and --from-stage <s> [FIX IN DESIGN: the Given says "the runner is invoked with both auto-resume active and --from-stage <s>" without mentioning explicit --resume; the design's Gap 12 fix moves the --from-stage validation guard to execute before the auto-resume check (see DSFSTG-4 And: "the guard fires before auto-resume runs, so auto-resume never processes state"), so any invocation with auto-resume conditions met, --from-stage given, and no explicit --resume hits that guard and exits 1 before the dispatch loop; the Then assertions ("stage.start is emitted for each stage after <s>") are unreachable when the Given is taken literally, because DSFSTG-4 fires first; for the scenario to reach the dispatch loop, explicit --resume must also be in the invocation, but the Given does not state it — it cannot be true together with that; make them agree]
  When: The dispatch loop reaches units after <s>
  Then: stage.start (or cycle.start) is emitted for each stage after <s>, even though those stages are marked complete in the interrupted run's state
  And: No stage.skip event is emitted for any stage after <s>

answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — the scenario it describes (resume skip guard activating for leaf stages after the targeted cycle in combined `--resume --from-stage <s>` mode) is already addressed by Gap 11 in the architectural decision: immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage` in both the `cycle:*` and `stage:*` dispatch arms, `resume_mode` is also set to false (`[[ -n "$skip_until_stage" ]] && { skip_until_stage=""; resume_mode=false; }`). This prevents the resume skip guard from activating for stages after `<s>`. Pure resume runs (no from-stage) never set `skip_until_stage`, so this line is unreachable in that path. DSFSTG-3[code] provides the observable test: a 3-unit fixture [intake, cyc, verify] where all three are marked complete; in combined mode with `--from-stage cyc`, `verify` must still emit stage.start. The test fails on the unfixed code (verify silently skipped) and passes after the Gap 11 fix (Finding 30 and Finding 31 in the design document).
